name: chronal_resonance_lapse
label: Chronal Resonance Lapse
poeticVision: The harrowing sensation of your own personal timeline lurching forward, a sudden internal 'fast-forward' caused by retrieving a potent memory fragment. You gain clarity, but for a critical moment, you become a spectral blur, out of sync with the world, leaving you acutely vulnerable to the Silence that hunts the ripples of your temporal instability.

parameters.name: lapse_duration
parameters.description: The duration, in seconds, for which Lyra experiences the chronal resonance lapse.

parameters.name: lapse_speed_multiplier
parameters.description: The multiplier applied to Lyra's internal delta time during the lapse, making her move and animate faster relative to the world.

parameters.name: vulnerability_multiplier
parameters.description: A multiplier indicating how much more vulnerable Lyra is to damage during the lapse. This value is for external game systems to interpret.

parameters.name: lapse_shader_intensity
parameters.description: The intensity of the visual shader effects (desaturation, tint, ghosting) during the lapse, ranging from 0.0 (no effect) to 1.0 (full effect).

parameters.name: mesh_instance_path
parameters.description: NodePath to Lyra's MeshInstance3D node, which should have the 'chronal_resonance_lapse.gdshader' applied.

parameters.name: animation_player_path
parameters.description: NodePath to Lyra's AnimationPlayer node, whose speed will be scaled during the lapse.

dependencies: MeshInstance3D (child of Lyra, for visual effects)
AnimationPlayer (child of Lyra, for animation speed control)
verdict: A brilliant temporal paradox, where the clarity of memory is paid for in moments of perilous, accelerated vulnerability, perfectly weaving narrative and challenge.
impact: This mechanic transforms memory retrieval from a simple narrative beat into a high-stakes, adrenaline-fueled gameplay challenge. Players will constantly weigh the urgency of gaining clarity against the immediate, harrowing vulnerability it imposes, forcing tactical decision-making and precise execution to survive the Silence's relentless pursuit, deeply integrating the themes of self-loss and survival into every action.
